outcome: clinical presentation of AWE (palpable mass, cyclic pain)
cohort: The study included 31 patients with a history of cesarean section who underwent surgery for abdominal wall endometriosis excision at the University of Naples Federico II, Italy.
finding: The primary finding was that no recurrent abdominal wall endometriosis nodules were detected in any patient at the 12-month follow-up after surgical excision and abdominal wall reconstruction, suggesting the effectiveness of this approach.
mod_finding: Abdominal wall endometriosis (AWE) is a rare pathological condition that mostly occurs in the post-cesarean section.
